mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods with FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% shows no statistically significant positive mean compared to the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
